Dear Bobbie, Do you

[Intro]
[C]remember when you were young and very
[Em]pretty? I do. I remem-
[C]ber pleated skirts, black and white sat-
[Em]tle shoes. Do you remember
[C]dancing that night? I do,
[Em]I still think of you when we
[C]dance, Although we cant
[Em]jitterbug as we did then.

[Verse 1]
[C]Do you remember when,
[Am]How long has it been?
[C]nineteenfourtyfive
[Am]you opened my blue eyes,
[Fmaj7]To see a whole new life.
[G6]Do you remember when,
[C]I told you this that night,
[Am]That if you're by my side,
[C]When everyday begins,
[Am]I'll fall for you again.
[Fmaj7]I made a promise when,
[G6]I told you this that night.

[Pre-Chorus]
[Fmaj7]That I'll be fine.
Cause When I die,

[Chorus]
[C]then I [Gsus4]die loving
[Am]you. It's alright,
[Fmaj7]I'll be fi-
ne. When I die
[C]then I [Gsus4]die loving
[Am]you, Loving you,
[Dm]
[F]loving you.

[Interlude]
[C]Do you remember the times we
[Em]would give up on each other
[C]and get back together. Then we
[Em]finally was married in
[C]nineteenfourtynine. We
[Em]drove the yellow converti-
[C]ble on our honey-
[Em]moon. Do you remember? I do.

[Verse 2]
[C]Life has led us here,
[Am]Together all these years.
[C]This house that we have made,
[Am]Holds twentythousand days.
[Fmaj7]And memories we've saved,
[G6]Since life has lead us here

[Pre-Chorus]
[Fmaj7]And I'll be fine.
(I'll be fine) Cause when I die,

[Chorus]
[C]then I [Gsus4]die loving
[Am]you. It's alright
[Fmaj7](it's alright), I'll be fine.
(I'll be fine) Cause when I die
[C]then I [Gsus4]die loving
[Am]you, Loving you,
[Dm]
[F]loving you.

[Interlude]
[C]
[Em]
[C]
[Em]
[C]
[Em]
[Fmaj7]
[G6]

[Bridge]
[C]I'm coming home to you,
[Am]Stepping off my shoes.
[C]Resting in my chair.
[Am]I see you standing there,
[Fmaj7]The silver in your hair.
[G6]I'm coming home to you,
[C]When I lay tonight,
[Am]when I close my eyes,
[C]I know the sun will rise,
[Am]Here or the next life.
[Fmaj7]As long as your still mine,
[G6]then its alright.
[Fmaj7]I'll be fine.
(I'll be fine) Cause when I die,

[Chorus]
[C]then I [Gsus4]die loving
[Am]you. It's alright
[Fmaj7](it's alright), I'll be fine.
(I'll be fine) Cause when I die
[C]then I [Gsus4]die loving
[Am]you, Loving you,
[Dm]
[F]loving you.

[Outro]
[C]You have gray hair now, But you're a beauti-
[Em]ful women, And the years have been
[C]good to both of us. We walk slow
[Em]now, but we still have each o-
[C]ther. The glue of love is
[Em]still bonding us together.
[C]That is what I re-
[Em]member. Do you remember?
[C]
title: Dear Bobbie
